required_columns.consent_call: boolean, non-null; unknown or conflicting means false
required_columns.consent_sms: boolean, non-null; unknown or conflicting means false
required_columns.consent_email: boolean, non-null; unknown or conflicting means false

identity_crosswalk.grain: one row per source_system and source_customer_id

required_columns.source_system: string: crm, cards, lending, core_banking, or collections
required_columns.golden_customer_id: string or null; null when unlinked

join_rule: For collections_cases, join coll_customer_ref to identity_crosswalk.source_customer_id where source_system = 'collections' and link_status = 'linked'. For CRM-keyed contacts, promises, and notes, use source_system = 'crm'.
quality_rules: each source_system and source_customer_id pair maps to at most one golden_customer_id
unlinked and review_pending records are not used for customer-level answers or decisions
protected attributes are excluded from golden_customers and decision features
